rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: SuperAgent MCP server orchestrates Codex and Gemini CLI agents with parallel execution support, enabling delegation of complex tasks to specialized programming agents. Built by SuperClaude Org, it provides two main tools for running multiple prompts concurrently across different working directories, with Codex offering full system access and comprehensive permissions while Gemini runs in auto-approval YOLO mode. The implementation includes a library of 16 specialized agent personas (backend architect, security engineer, python expert, etc.) that can be invoked to apply domain-specific expertise, making it valuable for complex development workflows, code analysis, system architecture tasks, and scenarios where different types of technical expertise need to be applied simultaneously across multiple projects or contexts.
